headline: DoorDash and Delivery Platforms See Demand Spike Following GTA 6 Launch
summary: Food delivery applications including DoorDash are experiencing sharp demand increases following the release of the video game GTA 6, as large numbers of stay-at-home gamers drive restaurant order volumes.
why: DoorDash is the leading meal delivery platform in the United States. Cultural and gaming entertainment releases can create pronounced, temporary surges in online ordering volumes.

impacts.name: DoorDash
impacts.why: DoorDash and food delivery peers are seeing a boost in customer orders linked to the GTA 6 release.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
